title: "stop sensor" function on menu should not be overridden by restart sensor or preemptive restarts.
body: For a while now (on nightlies) using stop sensor to change a sensor site has resulted in an auto start moments later asking for a calibration simply a restart. I have to try stopping 2 or 3 times to be able to trigger the sensor start process properly. If I change site, then quickly do a stop/start in rapid succession it seems to work in proper manner.

comments.body:
I am seeing this also.  I just asked about it on the forum and quickly heard from 4 others seeing the same issue.  Here is my description of the issue:
When we are ready to change sensors, we hit the Stop Sensor option.  A few minutes later I see "Attempting to auto-start sensor" in the logs. Another five minutes later, after we have put on a new sensor and inserted the transmitter, there is no Start Sensor button. I have to select Stop Sensor again in order to get a Start Sensor button so I can type in the calibration code.

Certainly.
Just expected it to be closed if attached to a bug by someone else I guess.
I had not seen the issue a few builds later.
